tasks.text: I am a student at Greenwood Elementary School.
Every morning, I wake up early and get ready for school.
My backpack is heavy because I carry my book and notebook every day.
In my classroom, there are twenty desks and one big whiteboard.
My teacher, Ms. Johnson, is very kind and patient.
She teaches us English, Math, and Science.
I love learning new things every day.
After school, I go to the library to read.
I want to become a scientist when I grow up.
